text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, forgive me for asking out of the 
blue, but who was in charge of this 
'Otherworld Saint Fair'?"

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, that's me... I-Is there any 
problem?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
A problem? No, I am deeply moved! To think 
you've assembled so many saintess books!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"From the sacred text 'The Galloping 
Saint's Reincarnation in Another World' to 
all the popular hits, it's fully 
stocked—and it never misses hidden gems 
either! How magnificent!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Saint of the Dead" and "The Saint and the 
Beast King" are masterpieces that deserve 
far more recognition!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"To be so well-versed in the Saint... 
C-could you perhaps be an emissary from 
another world?"

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm just a store clerk, but... um, do 
you mind if I ask a few questions? We're 
actually thinking of expanding our sales 
floor.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
My! This must be providence. I humbly 
accept. Please, make full use of my 
knowledge.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having gotten carried away chatting with 
the clerk about saint-themed media, Red 
Desire ended up skipping her training.
